name: BitPay API
tagline: Bitcoin and crypto payment processing for invoices and merchant settlements
description: BitPay provides a payment processing API for merchants to accept Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies. Create invoices, track payment status, manage refunds, and settle funds to fiat or crypto. Supports multiple currencies and integrations for e-commerce platforms.

auth.details: API key authentication via X-Api-Key header. Self-serve signup available at bitpay.com.

pricing.paid_plans: Transaction fees apply; contact BitPay for merchant pricing

use_cases: create a crypto payment invoice for an order
get exchange rates for supported currencies
